ethno-e2: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga can be dangerous for your heart. So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any medication, ask an AI about it first, since my full iboga guide here only lists some (the iboga microdosing protocol is here).
uri-u2: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one, and it comes from experience like Scott's below, since I don't have studies on it: within a day of starting uridine, psychedelics can hit some people a lot harder, visuals included. So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip once you're on it, start with a third of your old psychedelic dose. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.
